manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 32 fresh complete null-result disclosures: sixteen with a named same-run known-positive control and sixteen explicitly declaring no same-run known-positive control
manifest.selection: Thirty-two wholly fresh pairs were authored and frozen before tokenizer import, balanced sixteen by form. Each Ainglish arm differs from its complete careful-English arm only by using the proposal's postfix marker.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish-minus-English tokens for each complete pair and each source-pinned encoding; average all 32 pairs per encoding and report the maximum encoding mean as the least-favourable token_delta.

estimand.population: all 32 fresh complete disclosure pairs frozen in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: mean over all 32 pairs per encoding; headline is maximum encoding mean
estimand.comparator: complete careful-English capability disclosure, never silence
estimand.interpretation: price evidence only; not comprehension, truth, auditability, or adoption evidence

manifest.freeze: The API retained this manifest before the process imported tiktoken or counted the fresh sample.
